label: rem:q-oper-hecke-sketch
title: Proof sketch: $q$-opers produce eigensheaves
html:
Remark. Proof sketch: q-opers produce eigensheaves

The q-oper abla_q defines a point in \mathrm{LocSys}_{\check{G}_q}(X). Under the conjectured equivalence \mathbb{L}_q (q-GL conjecture), its pre-image \mathcal{M}_{ abla_q} = \mathbb{L}_q^{-1}(\delta_{ abla_q}) is a q-\mathcal{D}-module on \mathrm{Bun}_{G_q}. Hecke compatibility (property (1) of the conjecture) immediately ensures that \mathcal{M}_{ abla_q} is an eigensheaf with eigenvalue abla_q.

To prove irreducibility, suppose \mathcal{N} \subset \mathcal{M}_{ abla_q} is a non-zero sub-q-\mathcal{D}-module. The equivalence \mathbb{L}_q maps \mathcal{N} to a non-zero subsheaf of \delta_{ abla_q}. Because skyscraper sheaves are simple, \mathbb{L}_q(\mathcal{N}) = \delta_{ abla_q}. The equivalence then forces \mathcal{N} = \mathcal{M}_{ abla_q}.

Alternatively, irreducibility follows directly from the q-oper transversality condition. A proper sub-q-\mathcal{D}-module would induce a abla_q-invariant sub-bundle compatible with the Borel reduction. This contradicts the non-vanishing requirement \mathrm{pr}_{-\alpha_i}( abla_q mod \check{\mathfrak{b}}_q) eq 0. \square
